nodes.title: Dual store with access wall
nodes.summary: Jeff Teaching Graph (jeff-*) is the only student-probeable doctrine store. Dev / Cursor wiki (dev-*) is builder memory and must never be mounted for students.

nodes.title: Repo-first storage
nodes.summary: Proof of concept validation keeps both stores as markdown and JSON in git. A later student serving database may export only jeff-* rebuilt from git.

nodes.title: Closed Jeff allowlist
nodes.summary: Doctrine comes only from allowlisted Jeff materials under raw/jeff after compile. No open-web RAG for doctrine; search stays inside jeff-wiki and jeff-graph.

nodes.title: Generally → Jeff → steer
nodes.summary: Out of coverage uses warm teacher’s-pet voice: light general framing, pivot to Jeff’s taught direction, concrete next question. Never KB-meta refuse, never relativize other educators, never invent Jeff rules.

nodes.title: Sufficiency before student frontend
nodes.summary: Prove Jeff Teaching Graph answers pass golden and adversarial bars before building student UI. Limited release still uses jeff-* only and the same steer rules.

nodes.title: Karpathy compile-then-probe
nodes.summary: Immutable raw sources compile into wiki plus schema-driven graph; agents run ingest, query, and lint — not ad-hoc chat over uncompiled PDFs.

nodes.title: Open-web RAG for doctrine
nodes.summary: Rejected: pulling third-party web pages to invent or complete Jeff teaching.

nodes.title: Single mixed student+builder wiki
nodes.summary: Rejected: one store for both audiences collapses the access wall and leaks builder memory.

nodes.title: KB-meta refuse to students
nodes.summary: Rejected: telling students the knowledge base lacks Jeff teaching. Use Generally → Jeff → steer instead.

nodes.title: Relativizing other educators
nodes.summary: Rejected: framing rival methods as equally acceptable under Jeff’s approach.
